summary: The implementation fully satisfies REQ-1. A new LeadsPage component was created that uses the existing useAllLeads hook to fetch and display all lead records in a table format with all required fields. The page includes proper loading, error, and empty state handling, and timestamps are formatted in human-readable format. The page was integrated into the application routing and navigation as expected.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a 'Leads' navigation link in the Header component
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not specify adding navigation menu items. It only requested creating a page/section to display leads, not modifying the navigation structure.

hallucinated_features.description: Added total leads count display below the table
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not request any aggregate statistics or count displays. Only the table with lead records was specified.
